extraction.name: Hario Switch 20:260
extraction.short_description: Immersion-then-drain Switch recipe with pre-timer fill and dose
extraction.preparation: Rinse the filter with hot water and close the switch so it's in immersion mode.

steps.raw_text: Rinse the filter with hot water and close the switch so it's in immersion mode.
Fill the brewer with 260 grams of water at around 94 degrees.
Add your 20 grams of coffee straight into the water.
We're gonna start the timer when we start our stir, so give it a good stir right as you hit start.
At the 40 second mark, open the switch and let it start draining into the cup below.
Let it fully steep and drain until about 1:25, then pull the Switch off the cup and you're done.
